name: Edgewell Personal Care Company
summary: Edgewell Personal Care Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets personal care products worldwide. It operates in two segments, Wet Shave; and Sun and Skin Care. The Wet Shave segment offers razor systems, such as razor handles and refillable blades, and disposable shave products for men and women under the Schick and Wilkinson Sword brands; shave preparation products comprising shaving gels and creams under the Edge, Skintimate, Billie, Shave Guard brands; and private label and disposable razors, shaving systems, and replacement blades.
